spekboom.definition:
n. The purslane tree of South Africa, -- said to be the
   favorite food of elephants.

speke.definition: n. English explorer who with Sir Richard Burton was the first European to explore Lake Tanganyika; he also discovered Lake Victoria and named it (1827-1864)

spekes.definition:
-s form of Speke
n. English explorer who with Sir Richard Burton was the first European to explore Lake Tanganyika; he also discovered Lake Victoria and named it (1827-1864)
spekes.translation: (Speke 的第三人称 -s形式) n. (Speke)人名；(英)斯皮克
